title: Things to know for Comic-Con 2026!
description:
Comic‑Con 2026 is almost here! From July 23–26 (preview night is July 22), San Diego transforms into a city‑wide pop‑culture festival. 💥 

Ride the trolley!🚋 A special events line will run every 15 minutes between Balboa Avenue Transit Center and 12th & Imperial – with stops along the Green and Blue lines.

Need a costume fix? 🧵Stop by the free Cosplay Repair Station at the Central Library IDEA Lab, 4th floor. 330 Park Blvd, San Diego, CA. It's open Thursday, July 23 and Friday, July 24, from 11 a.m.-5 p.m. and Saturday, July 25, from 1 p.m.-5 p.m.

Get the official Comic-Con library card! Available starting Thursday, July 23, at San Diego Public Library locations, while supplies last. ⚡Swap your card for free throughout July. California residents can also sign up for a free library card.

Harbor Drive between First Ave & Park Blvd will be closed to general traffic during peak hours. ⚠️  Emergency vehicles, ADA users and badged attendees with parking passes only.

No drones are allowed. 🚫 

Things you can bring include refillable water bottles, portable phone charger, snacks, sunscreen and
deodorant. ✅

Have a great time!
#CityOfSanDiego #SanDiego #ComicCon #SDCC
